output.content:
**Glucose comparison, CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01 (exact matched elapsed times), from the Northfield Biologics · November runs delivery:**

- **Mean signed difference:** −0.207 g/L (9 matched samples, 0–146 h)
- **Largest absolute difference:** 0.555 g/L, occurring at **18.0 h elapsed** (CHO-007-R01: 7.83 g/L vs CHO-007-R02: 7.275 g/L)
- **Batches compared:** CHO-007-R01 and CHO-007-R02

The differences are negative at 8 of 9 matched times — CHO-007-R01 reads higher than CHO-007-R02 nearly throughout, with the gap widest early in the run. CHO-007-R01 has one unmatched sample at 44.0 h (CHO-007-R02 has no value at exactly 44.0 h; its 44 h entry is a conflicting duplicate pending source review), so 9 of 10 R01 samples were matched (90%).

**Provisional status:** These values come from the Northfield Biologics · November runs delivery, which is still in review — values were read from the delivery files and have not been checked by a reviewer, and the delivery has open checks (including the 44 h duplicate conflict noted above and missing/unmapped fields). The other deliveries you included in review — Harborview CDMO · fed-batch runs and Northfield Biologics · October runs — were not part of this glucose comparison. This is a descriptive comparison only: batch context (product, process version, equipment, scale, stage) is not recorded for either batch, so no cause or significance is claimed.
